_comment: An ink is a pigment carried in a vehicle, so what it wants is a grit, and gloomgrit is one: a drab
powder scraped off a vent's lining whose whole interest is in what it becomes. It takes the grit rather
than the phasmium grains it otherwise makes on purpose -- the grains are meant to have exactly one
purpose, which is to stop being grains.
Deretheni is the danger material, which design 7.1.1 asks both mid-tier rungs to carry, and being
jet-black it is also the colourant, which nothing else in the pack is. A pigment has to be ground, so
it comes from the grinder as dust.
Two gloomgrit because refining should cost more than the ink itself, not less.
